'''Toria''' (Japanese: '''トリア''' ''Toria'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[JN122|It's... Champion Time!]]''.

Toria first appeared alongside [[Vic]] as they approached {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and {{an|Cynthia}} outside [[Wyndon Stadium]]. Toria was super excited to see their Pokémon, causing Vic to try and hold her back. Toria was allowed to touch Ash's Pokémon and later ran off after a {{p|Gossifleur}}.

Toria went missing and was found watching the Gossifleur and witnessed it evolving into an {{p|Eldegoss}} and watched as it flew away. Vic realized the match with {{an|Leon}} and [[Diantha]] was underway and she hurried to Wyndon Stadium and watched the battle.

In ''[[JN125|Whittle While You Work!]]'', Toria was shown watching Ash's battle against Cynthia.
